newsitem.title: UK: BA gains as SBC Warburg repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: BA gains as SBC Warburg repeats "buy".

text.p: Shares in British Airways Plc rose on Tuesday as analysts at SBC Warburg repeated a "buy" rating and a 750p price target in a review of the transport sector, dealers said.
The stock was up 15-1/2p at 665 by 1432 GMT in volume of 2.2 million shares.
Analysts at Warburg were not immediately available for comment.

Separately Australian airline Qantas, 25 percent owned by BA, said passengers carried increased 6.6 percent to 11.05 million in the seven months to January 31 with revenue passenger kilometres up eight percent.
